assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent cutout sprite for a dark gothic mobile social deduction game, not a poster. Primary request: a formidable horned demon with enormous crimson bat wings fully spread horizontally, framed as a single isolated full-body creature, clearly readable at small screen sizes. Style: refined hand-painted dark oil illustration, believable materials and anatomy, restrained Victorian gothic fantasy, realistic chiaroscuro brushwork rather than cartoon, matching black-gold character portraits. Composition: symmetrical frontal silhouette, wide wings fill most of a landscape canvas, visible complete tips, centered narrow torso and taloned hands, both feet visible, generous transparent padding around every edge. True transparent background with alpha; no scenery, no smoke cloud outside silhouette, no ground plane, no border, no lettering, no watermarks. Avoid photorealistic gore or exposed organs. The wings must be the dominant visual and are meant to unfold dramatically through CSS animation.

True transparent background alpha, no environment, no tray, no tea service, no floor shadow extending beyond feet, no border, no frame, no text or watermark. Face calm and respectful, not smiling or caricatured.

No captions, no logos, no border, no watermark. This is the evil faction victory backdrop.
